title: 第25章 昆尸
content_zh:
第25章 昆尸-《我发现了世界BUG》

上一章

存书签

下一章

林舒觉得这个甲方很蠢。

不是那种一般意义上的蠢，而是一种轻忽、狂妄、自大的蠢。

他甚至都没有用任何其他方法验证自己的身份，也没有对钱包链接变更发出疑问。

----当然，在灰产行业里，换钱包链接确实是一件相当普遍的事情。

这玩意儿又没有实名验证，随便找个理由就能敷衍过去。

但你总得问一嘴吧？问都不问就打过去3万U，你是太自信，还是人傻钱多？

最好是人傻钱多。

精明的对手，总是会给人很强的心理压力。

而如果只是钱多一点，那反而就像是一只肥羊了......

林舒没有再纠结于甲方，也没有过于执着地一定要当场找出真相。

很多事情必须要慢慢来。

就像钓鱼，如果鱼还没把钩咬死，那就还没到提杆的时候。

且看吧！

他把手机插好充电，看了一眼时间，晚上8点。

距离上一次自己进行蓍龟占卜已经又过去了73个小时，三天的冷却期，已经转完了。

是时候看看自己下一次的死相了！

站起身来，林舒一件一件地整理好仪轨所需要的道具。

一边整理，他也一边在心里暗暗归纳。

第一次进行蓍龟占卜的仪轨时，自己使用的是“最简易版本”，只用了龟甲、蓍草，只念了一条咒语。

在这样的简易版本中，自己看到的画面虽然准确，但也相当模糊。

而到了第二次，在简易版仪轨的基础上，自己借助徐长顺留下的遗产，在仪轨中加入了犀角香、加入了命龟手决。

这两个新增的步骤确认是有效的，它让自己看到的画面变得更清晰了。

那这一次，能不能再增加一些步骤？

思索片刻，林舒打开了徐长顺的电脑，找到了“蓍龟占卜”一节，在文档中查到了徐长顺归纳总结的、有可能提升蓍龟占卜效果的步骤。

大部分步骤都已经被验证过，但由于“地法时言”四要素的随时变动，再加上徐长顺在实验时缺少进行“严格对照实验”的思维，每一个独立步骤的效果并不清晰。

不过即便如此，全部归纳总结起来看，林舒还是敏锐地发现，有一个步骤，是大概率能进一步提升占卜效果的。

那就是，烧甲的方式。

《周礼》记载：“春灼后左，夏灼前左，秋灼前右，冬灼后右”。

在不同的季节需要灼烧龟甲的不同部位，才能让占卜准确。

而在之前，自己并没有遵守这条规则。

这一次，再把这条规则加入进去，看看结果如何。

林舒在电脑里新开了一个文档，把所有蓍龟占卜的所有步骤全部写了下来，随后又用分割线分隔开，记录下了时间、日期和具体操作步骤。

这叫什么？

颗粒度！

Lin Shu thinks this Party A is stupid.

Not stupid in the ordinary sense, but a kind of ignorance, arrogance, and arrogance.

He didn’t even verify his identity using any other method or raise questions about the wallet link change.

----Of course, in the gray industry, changing wallet links is indeed a very common thing.

There is no real-name verification in this thing, so you can just find any excuse and get over it.

But you have to ask, right?I called you over 30,000 U without asking. Are you too confident, or are you stupid and rich?

It’s best if people are stupid and have a lot of money.

Smart opponents will always put strong psychological pressure on people.

And if you just have a little more money, you will be like a fat sheep...

Lin Shu no longer struggled with Party A, nor was he too persistent in finding out the truth on the spot.

A lot of things have to be done slowly.

Just like fishing, if the fish hasn't bitten the hook yet, it's not time to lift the pole yet.

Let’s see!

He plugged in his phone to charge and looked at the time: 8pm.

Another 73 hours have passed since the last time I performed a divination by a turtle, and the three-day cooling period has been completed.

It's time to see how you will die next time!

Standing up, Lin Shu arranged the props needed for the ritual one by one.

While sorting it out, he also secretly summarized it in his heart.

When I performed the yarrow divination ritual for the first time, I used the "simplest version", using only tortoise shells and yarrow, and recited only one incantation.

In this simple version, although the picture I saw was accurate, it was also quite blurry.

For the second time, based on the simplified version of the ritual, I used the legacy left by Xu Changshun to add rhinoceros horn incense and the Minggui Hand Jue to the ritual.

These two new steps confirm that they are effective and make the picture you see clearer.

So this time, can you add some more steps?

After thinking for a moment, Lin Shu opened Xu Changshun's computer and found the "Yarrow Turtle Divination" section. In the document, he found the steps Xu Changshun summarized that might improve the effect of the turtle divination.

Most of the steps have been verified, but due to the constant changes in the four elements of "local law, time and language", and Xu Changshun's lack of thinking in conducting "strictly controlled experiments" during the experiment, the effect of each independent step is not clear.

But even so, to sum up everything, Lin Shu still keenly discovered that there is a step that can further improve the divination effect with a high probability.

That is, the way to burn armor.

"Zhou Li" records: "The spring burns on the back left, the summer burns on the front left, the autumn burns on the right, and the winter burns on the back right."

In different seasons, different parts of the tortoise shell need to be burned to make the divination accurate.

But before, I didn't follow this rule.

This time, add the rule again and see what happens.

Lin Shu opened a new document on his computer and wrote down all the steps of the turtle divination. Then he separated them with dividing lines and recorded the time, date and specific operation steps.

What is this called?

Granularity!
